description.value: Burger Factory is a franchised Canadian smash-burger chain emphasising fresh, halal, and locally-sourced ingredients, now with over 40 locations across North America. The Nanaimo unit offers a broad menu including signature stuffed 'Juicy Lucy' burgers, Philly-style sandwiches, poutine, tornado fries, and funnel cakes. Cyclists can order ahead via the chain's mobile app for a quick fuel stop.
